content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IIT Delhi Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IIT Delhi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Jr. Research Fellow and 2 for Project Scientist.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Jr. Research Fellow: Post Graduate Degree in basic science with NET qualification or Graduate Degree in professional course with NET qualification or Post Graduate Degree with professional course. Project Scientist: B.Tech/ M.Sc/ MCA/ Post Graduate in relevant discipline having 1st class or equivalent in the appropriate discipline.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Jr. Research Fellow: Rs.37,000/- p.m. plus HRA @27% Project Scientist: Rs.35400-40400-43600-46800-50000/-p.m. plus HRA

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Jr. Research Fellow and Project Scientist positions at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Jr. Research Fellow?
faq.answer: For the Jr. Research Fellow position, candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in basic science with NET qualification or a Graduate Degree in a professional course with NET qualification or a Post Graduate Degree with a professional course.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Scientist role ranges from Rs.35400 to Rs.50000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, New Delhi - 110016.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the Important Links section provided in this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
